ten: Higher order Orderblocks + Breakerblocks + Range + Alerts (script title 'Order Blocks')
mo_ta: Uses second-order pivots (a pivot of pivots). A market structure break of the low that created the most recent higher high creates a supply OB at that high. Zones pass through untested, tested, breaker and deleted states, all driven by pivots.
ICT rejection block: the long wick of a swing-extreme candle (from the body edge to the wick tip) is the zone. It gives signals on the first retest and on a close through the zone.

Trend-cross order block: when a fast EMA crosses a slow EMA, the most extreme candle of the last N bars becomes the OB. Zones have an ATR-based minimum height, merge when close together, and show accumulated volume.

ten: Pure Price Action Order & Breaker Blocks [LuxAlgo]
mo_ta: Same OB and breaker lifecycle as Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks, but the swings come from nested 3-bar fractals (short, intermediate and long term) instead of a length setting.
Classic textbook OB: the last opposite-colour candle before a run of same-direction candles.

OB = the extreme candle between a swing point and the close that breaks it. When price closes through the OB it flips into a breaker block (reverse polarity), which is deleted when price closes back through its other side.
Volume-pivot order block: the OB candle is the bar with a local volume peak, and its direction comes from whether that bar is a local price high or low.

ten: Smart Money Concepts (SMC) [LuxAlgo] (order block part only)
mo_ta: Order block = the most extreme candle of the pullback leg that sits between a swing point and the candle that closes through it (BOS/CHoCH). Two layers: internal OB (swing size 5) and swing OB (swing size 50).

ICT breaker: after a liquidity sweep (lower low) and a market structure shift (close above the swing high), the last up-candle at that swing high becomes a +BB. Signals fire on a retest-and-reject of the breaker.
Same swing-break OB core as LuxAlgo OB&BB, plus an ATR size filter, wick/close invalidation, merging of overlapping zones, and a volume split shown inside the box.
